runbooks.symptoms: Container terminated by kernel cgroup out-of-memory killer.
root_causes: Memory heap exhaustion during PDF generation or batch statement compilation.
Container memory limit configured below runtime working set.
Unbounded database query fetching all historical rows into memory.
mitigation_steps: 1. Check recent memory telemetry via az webapp log tail.
2. Issue safe restart of the affected App Service (az webapp restart --name <webapp>).
3. If recurring, scale App Service Plan memory or optimize database query batch size in remuneration_engine.py.
4. Notify team in Slack/Email with incident timestamp and scrubbed log trace.

runbooks.symptoms: Upstream proxy or FastAPI service returning 500/502/504 errors to client portal.
mitigation_steps: 1. Check database connection string and Supabase / PostgreSQL connectivity.
2. Verify environment variable configuration drift between .env.example and Azure AppSettings.
3. Review most recent GitHub commit deployment hash on main.
4. If recent commit introduced regression, trigger GitHub rollback dispatch.

runbooks.symptoms: Managed disks left in Unattached state after VM deletion or manual snapshot testing.
mitigation_steps: 1. Run az disk list --resource-group <rg> and check managedBy property.
2. If managedBy is null and disk is not designated as cold archive, queue deletion.
